vulnerability_analysis: The contract allows the owner to set arbitrarily high sell fees (liquidity and dev fees). By setting both to 99%, when selling tokens, 198% of the transaction would theoretically be taken as fees (though limited by the total amount). This causes most of the sell value to be captured as fees that accumulate in the contract. The owner can then withdraw these accumulated tokens using transferTokens().
attack_strategy: Impersonate the owner, set sell fees to maximum (99% each), acquire tokens, sell them on PancakeSwap, and withdraw the accumulated fees.
step_by_step_plan:
1. Impersonate the contract owner using vm.prank
2. Set sellLiquidityFeePercent to 99 and selldevFeePercent to 99
3. Get some xenoX tokens (buy from PancakeSwap or transfer from owner)
4. Approve PancakeRouter to spend our tokens
5. Perform a sell transaction via swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens
6. As owner, withdraw accumulated tokens from contract using transferTokens
7. Verify profit by checking attacker's BNB balance increase
